bugs.title: pH not scaled from millivolts
bugs.description: computePh returns millivolts directly instead of dividing by 500 mV/pH, so reported pH is ~500x too large and the alert LED is always on.

bugs.title: No hysteresis on fan threshold
bugs.description: Fan turns OFF as soon as temp drops below 42.0 °C instead of holding ON until 38.0 °C, so it chatters around the single trip point rather than using the required 42/38 band.

bugs.title: No rate limit on fan transitions
bugs.description: The 2-transitions-per-5000 ms limit is not implemented; with no hysteresis the relay can toggle every 50 ms sample, far exceeding the allowed rate.

bugs.title: Override release drops fan immediately
bugs.description: When the override is released, the fan state is recomputed from temperature alone, so a fan forced ON by override can snap OFF instantly even if temperature is above the ON threshold, and the override does not respect the transition rate limit.

bugs.title: LM35 scaling uses 5000 mV reference
bugs.description: analogRead is converted with 5000 mV/1023, but the Uno's default ADC reference is ~5 V with 1024 steps; using 1023 and assuming exactly 5000 mV biases the temperature reading, and the LM35 should be scaled as raw*5000/1024/10.

bugs.title: LED on wrong pin
bugs.description: LED_PIN is 12 but the pin map and behaviour specify D13; the user LED never lights on the intended pin.

bugs.title: held_ms reports timestamp not duration
bugs.description: pressMs is assigned millis() (an absolute timestamp) and printed as held_ms, so the serial output shows a huge timestamp instead of the elapsed hold time in ms.

bugs.title: Blink half-period drifts and first toggle delayed
bugs.description: lastBlink is reset to now on each toggle rather than advanced by BLINK_MS, so loop latency accumulates and the blink period exceeds ~120 ms; also the initial setLed(true) plus immediate toggle logic can produce an uneven first cycle.

bugs.title: Steady mode ignores blink-mode release timing
bugs.description: When D4 is released while D2 is held, the code sets LED HIGH but does not reset lastBlink/pressMs consistently, and switching from blink to steady leaves lit state dependent on prior toggle rather than forcing steady HIGH within 100 ms.

bugs.title: pct stream timing driven by sample count, not 1000 ms
bugs.description: pct: is printed whenever 50 samples accumulate (50 × ~20 ms loop ≈ 1000 ms plus ADC time), so the interval drifts and is not tied to millis; it can exceed the 1000 ms ±150 ms requirement and is not synchronized with the blend batches line.

bugs.title: Force button emits note every loop while held
bugs.description: Holding D5 LOW calls forceSampleNote() every iteration (with only a 30 ms delay), flooding serial with blend force lines instead of a single note per press, and the 30 ms delay also perturbs the pct timing.

bugs.title: No debounce/edge detection on force button
bugs.description: The button is read as a level with no edge detection or debounce, so a single press produces many notes and contact bounce produces extra notes.

bugs.title: ADC reference scaling assumes 5 V but uses default reference
bugs.description: rawToPct uses 5000 mV full-scale with the default (Vcc) reference; if Vcc differs from 5.0 V the percent reading is off, and the 10 mV/% scale is applied correctly only when the reference is exactly 5 V. Should use a stable reference or measure Vcc.

bugs.title: sum is int and can overflow
bugs.description: sum is a 16-bit int accumulating up to 50 ADC readings (max ~51150) which overflows signed int, corrupting the average and thus the printed percent.

bugs.title: lastStatus not volatile-safe / millis rollover handled but batches line not periodic with pct
bugs.description: The blend batches line is printed on its own 1000 ms timer independent of the pct timer, so the two streams drift apart and the batches count does not correspond to the pct prints at the same instant.

bugs.title: No hysteresis in fault recovery / fault band uses same thresholds as fire band
bugs.description: The fault thresholds (5/120 °C) are checked every tick and force the valve closed, but there is no separate recovery band; more importantly the fire band (70/75) and fault band are evaluated with the same instantaneous reading, so a noisy probe near 70 or 75 °C can chatter the valve. The behaviour requires a sustained in-range band crossing, which is not implemented.

bugs.title: No debounce on lockout key
bugs.description: D3 is read directly each 40 ms tick with no debounce, so a bouncing key can momentarily release lockout and open the valve.

bugs.title: ADC reference scaling assumes 5 V but uses 1023 divisor
bugs.description: mv = raw * (5000/1023) is a minor scaling choice, but combined with 10 mV/°C the reported temperature is slightly off; more critically the code never sets the analog reference, so if AREF differs the 10 mV/°C scale is wrong. The behaviour expects 10 mV/°C on the default 5 V reference.

bugs.title: Status print uses stale tempC and firing flag ordering
bugs.description: printStatus prints tempC and firing which are updated in the tick block; if the status interval fires before a tick update the printed value can lag, but the format itself matches. Minor.

bugs.title: No failsafe for out-of-range temperature
bugs.description: The behaviour requires the valve to be forced CLOSED when tempC > 120 °C or < 5 °C, but the sketch has no such check; a very low reading (e.g. open probe) would actually open the valve via the tempC < 70 branch, and a very high reading would only close it if it also exceeds 75 °C, never enforcing the 120 °C cutoff.

bugs.title: Missing hysteresis state machine
bugs.description: The code uses independent if/else-if thresholds without a latched firing state, so between 70 and 75 °C the valve state depends on which branch was last taken rather than holding the previous state; the intended 70/75 band hysteresis is not actually implemented as a state machine.

bugs.title: ADC conversion uses 5000 mV reference instead of 1100 mV
bugs.description: analogRead is scaled with 5000/1023 but the LM35 output is only ~0.18–0.22 V, so the computed temperature is ~4.5x too high (e.g. 20 °C reads ~91 °C), keeping the heater permanently OFF. Use the internal 1.1 V reference (analogReference(INTERNAL)) and scale by 1100/1023.

bugs.title: Integer division truncates millivolt reading
bugs.description: analogRead(TEMP_PIN) * 5000 / 1023 is integer arithmetic; with the correct 1100 mV reference the product still fits, but the truncation to whole millivolts loses resolution and the expression must be evaluated in a wider/float type to avoid truncation errors near the band edges.

bugs.title: No stop threshold / missing hysteresis
bugs.description: Pump is turned off as soon as level drops below 45.0 cm instead of at 30.0 cm, so it chatters around the start mark rather than using the 45/30 band.

bugs.title: No toggle-rate limit
bugs.description: Nothing enforces the max 2 pump toggles per 5000 ms window; with a noisy level near a threshold the contactor can toggle far faster than allowed.

bugs.title: Silence button not debounced
bugs.description: D4 is read raw each loop with no debounce, so contact bounce or noise can spuriously latch silence mode.

bugs.title: ADC scaling uses 1023 instead of 1024
bugs.description: mV conversion uses 5000/1023 rather than 5000/1024, biasing the reported level slightly high (minor but systematic).

bugs.title: Floating sensor not detected as fault
bugs.description: A floating A3 input reads an arbitrary mid-range voltage that maps to a plausible temperature, so the fault check (temp<0 or >60) never triggers and the compressor keeps running on a bad probe. The behaviour requires forcing OFF when the sensor is floating.

bugs.title: No hysteresis between ON/OFF thresholds in hold logic
bugs.description: The onHold/offHold counters are independent, so between 4 and 8 °C neither counter reaches HOLD_N and the compressor simply latches its previous state — but the band logic is fragile: a temperature oscillating around 8 °C can toggle ON after 3 ticks then immediately begin counting offHold, and there is no explicit deadband state machine, so the commanded state can chatter at the band edges rather than holding until the opposite threshold is crossed.

bugs.title: ADC reference/scaling assumes 5 V but uses 1023 divisor
bugs.description: mv = raw*(5000/1023) is fine for a 5 V reference, but the sketch never sets analogReference and the Uno default is 5 V — acceptable — however the real issue is the 10 mV/°C scale is applied to a 0–5 V range giving 0–500 °C, so a floating pin near mid-rail (~2.5 V) reads ~250 °C which is >60 and would fault; but a pin floating near 0.3 V reads ~30 °C and passes as valid, so floating detection is unreliable (see b1).

bugs.title: Status print uses stale tempC and may print before first read
bugs.description: printStatus uses the last sampled tempC, which is fine, but on the very first loop iteration tempC is 0.0 before any read if STATUS_MS elapses first — minor; more importantly the printed value is the pre-fault sample, not necessarily reflecting the forced-OFF state timing.

bugs.title: 8-bit millis truncation breaks 800 ms period
bugs.description: nextDue and now8 are uint8_t, so millis() is truncated to 0-255 ms; the 800 ms period cannot be represented and the scheduler fires at wrong/erratic intervals (and the `now8 >= nextDue` guard plus 128 window makes timing unreliable). Use unsigned long for scheduling.

bugs.title: Pause resets period instead of resuming
bugs.description: While paused, nextDue is continuously pushed forward by PERIOD_MS every loop, so on release the first pulse is delayed by a full period rather than resuming the schedule; also the pulse-due check is gated by the truncated 8-bit arithmetic.

bugs.title: Pulse not forced LOW immediately on pause
bugs.description: If pause is pressed mid-pulse, D8 stays HIGH until pulseUntil elapses; behaviour requires D8 LOW while D4 is held LOW, so the pulse should be terminated immediately on pause.

bugs.title: No debounce/settle window
bugs.description: The sketch toggles on every raw HIGH-to-LOW transition with no 40 ms settle window, so contact bounce on press (and bounce-induced edges on release) will produce multiple toggles per physical press.

bugs.title: Release bounce can retrigger toggle
bugs.description: Because previousRaw is updated every loop with no debounce, a bounce sequence HIGH-LOW-HIGH-LOW during a single press/release can register multiple press edges, violating the 'exactly once per press' requirement.

bugs.title: Pulse length is 1000 ms not 2500 ms
bugs.description: PULSE_MS is set to 1000, so the solenoid HIGH pulse lasts 1 s instead of the required 2500 ms.

bugs.title: Debounce edge timer not reset on stable transition
bugs.description: trigEdge is only updated when raw changes; after a stable transition the timer is not re-armed, so a subsequent bounce within 25 ms of the previous edge can be accepted early, and the 25 ms stability window is measured from the last raw change rather than from the last stable sample, allowing a press shorter than 30 ms to register.

bugs.title: Trigger latency can exceed 120 ms
bugs.description: The debounce logic requires raw to differ from stableTrig for 25 ms after the last edge, but because trigEdge is not refreshed on stable acceptance, a press arriving just after a prior edge can be delayed by up to ~50 ms plus loop jitter; combined with the missing re-arm this can push detection past the 120 ms requirement.

bugs.title: Missing hysteresis on fan control
bugs.description: The fan turns off as soon as temperature drops below 28.0 °C, but the behaviour requires turning off only at or below 24.0 °C, causing rapid toggling around the setpoint.

bugs.title: No rate limiting on fan state changes
bugs.description: The fan can change state on every 50 ms tick, violating the requirement that it must not change more than 2 times in any 5000 ms window.

bugs.title: Missing failsafe for out-of-range or floating probe
bugs.description: Temperatures below 5.0 °C, above 100.0 °C, or a floating probe (e.g., near 0 V or 5 V) are not detected; the fan is not forced ON within 600 ms and held in the safe state.

bugs.title: Incorrect ADC scaling
bugs.description: The code uses 5000.0/1023.0 mV per count instead of the correct 5000.0/1024.0, causing a small but systematic temperature error.

bugs.title: Status print uses stale temperature
bugs.description: The status line prints tempC from the last tick, which may be up to 50 ms old, but more importantly the print timing is independent of the sample and can show a value not matching the current fan state during transitions.

bugs.title: No rate limit on fan toggling
bugs.description: The sketch has no 5000 ms / 2-transition limiter; a temperature hovering near the 30/26 thresholds can toggle the fan far more than twice per 5 s window.

bugs.title: Floating probe not detected
bugs.description: A floating A0 reads an arbitrary voltage that may land inside 5–100 °C, so the required force-ON safe state is never entered; there is no open-circuit/rail detection.

bugs.title: Fault force-ON latency too slow
bugs.description: Fault must force fan ON within 600 ms, but faultHold requires HOLD_N=4 ticks at 50 ms plus loop jitter; combined with the missing floating detection the 600 ms deadline is not reliably met.

bugs.title: ADC reference scaling assumes 5 V Vcc
bugs.description: readTempC uses 5000/1023 mV per count; with the default AVcc reference this mis-scales temperature if Vcc differs from 5.000 V, shifting the 30/26 °C trip points.

bugs.title: Status print uses stale temp on first tick
bugs.description: printStatus can run before the first 50 ms tick has populated tempC, printing 0.0 C on the first status line.

bugs.title: E-stop logic inverted
bugs.description: estopActive() returns true when D3 reads HIGH, but with INPUT_PULLUP the pin is HIGH when the e-stop is released and LOW when pressed. This makes the contactor drop when the e-stop is clear and energize when pressed — the opposite of the required fail-safe behaviour.

bugs.title: Contactor never follows run request
bugs.description: Both the runReq and else branches call setContactor(true), so the contactor is always HIGH whenever the e-stop is clear regardless of D6. The run request input is effectively ignored.

bugs.title: Trip count increments on release, not press
bugs.description: Because estopActive is inverted, tripCount++ fires on the release edge (HIGH transition) rather than when the e-stop is pressed, so trips counts the wrong events.

bugs.title: Hold threshold is 600 ms, not 500 ms
bugs.description: ARM_MS is 600, so the LED lights 600 ms after press start, violating the 500 ms hold and 550 ms deadline requirements.

bugs.title: Confirm logging blocks loop with delay(20)
bugs.description: Holding D5 LOW calls delay(20) every iteration, stalling the loop and delaying arm/release response and status timing; confirm should be edge-triggered without blocking.

bugs.title: Confirm floods serial every loop
bugs.description: While D5 is held, 'arm confirm' is printed every ~20 ms instead of once per press, spamming serial and starving the status output.

bugs.title: Pulse length is 2000 ms not 3000 ms
bugs.description: PULSE_MS is set to 2000, so the inject indicator on D4 goes HIGH for only 2 s instead of the required 3000 ms.

bugs.title: No 120 ms response deadline guarantee
bugs.description: The pulse starts only after the 30 ms debounce plus loop latency; while this usually meets 120 ms, the sketch has no explicit bound and the debounce edge timer is reset on every raw change, so a noisy contact can delay the settled press beyond 120 ms.

bugs.title: Blocking delay starves heartbeat
bugs.description: runSirenBurst() uses delay(2000), so the loop cannot print the 250 ms 'hb' heartbeat during the siren pulse, violating the requirement to print every 250 ms and never go silent >700 ms.

bugs.title: No debounce/hysteresis on door switch
bugs.description: doorOpen() reads the raw pin with no debounce or settle time, so contact bounce or noise can trigger spurious siren pulses instead of requiring a settled 40 ms press.

bugs.title: Siren pulse not non-retriggerable
bugs.description: The sirenArmed flag is set and cleared around a blocking call and never actually gates new presses; because the loop is blocked during the pulse, presses are effectively ignored only by accident, and the design does not implement the required 'ignore presses while pulse running' state machine.

bugs.title: No 150 ms response latency guarantee
bugs.description: Because the sketch blocks in delay() and has no timed debounce, there is no bounded path ensuring a settled 40 ms press starts the pulse within 150 ms; the timing is uncontrolled.

bugs.title: pH offset missing — raw mV/500 gives 0–10 pH, not real pH
bugs.description: The probe is linearized at 500 mV/pH but the sketch divides absolute millivolts by 500, so a 0 V probe reads pH 0.00 and a 5 V probe reads pH 10.00; the injected pH value is never recovered, so the ±0.20 accuracy requirement fails and the D10 band logic is driven by the wrong number.

bugs.title: ADC span uses 1023 instead of 1024
bugs.description: Using 5000/1023 instead of 5000/1024 introduces a small full-scale gain error (~0.1%), which alone is minor but compounds the missing offset; the correct ADC conversion for a 5.000 V reference is raw * 5000/1024.

bugs.title: Missing RUN exit condition
bugs.description: The state machine never leaves ST_RUN when the level drops below RUN_MIN_CM (20.0 cm), so the motor stays HIGH indefinitely instead of returning to IDLE.

bugs.title: Missing hysteresis on FILL entry
bugs.description: FILL is entered whenever level < 10.0 cm, but there is no separate lower threshold to prevent chatter; however the real issue is that the RUN exit threshold (20.0 cm) is not used, causing the motor to never stop.

bugs.title: No hysteresis on FILL entry threshold
bugs.description: FILL is entered whenever level < 10.0 cm, but the probe reading near the threshold will oscillate the state between IDLE and FILL on noise, toggling the valve rapidly; a small hysteresis band (e.g. enter FILL below 9.5 cm, exit only above 10.5 cm) is needed.

bugs.title: Reset not applied immediately
bugs.description: The reset button is only sampled inside the 40 ms tick block, so holding D4 LOW does not force IDLE 'immediately' and outputs can stay energized up to ~40 ms plus loop jitter; reset should be checked every loop iteration and drive outputs right away.

bugs.title: Motor cutoff latency not guaranteed
bugs.description: The 600 ms motor-off requirement is met only because the tick is 40 ms, but the level is sampled and the state machine evaluated only once per tick; combined with the reset check being inside the same block, a slow analogRead or serial blocking can push the motor-off past 600 ms. Sampling and output update should be decoupled from the status print and reset handled first.

bugs.title: No debounce window; bounce toggles multiple times
bugs.description: The settle logic only requires the raw level to be unchanged for 45 ms, but a bouncing contact re-arms edgeMs on every transition, so a 20 ms bounce burst can still produce multiple accepted LOW transitions and multiple toggles. A proper debounce must require the raw input to be stable for the full settle window before accepting a new state, and must not re-trigger on release.

bugs.title: Release can toggle lamp
bugs.description: Because stable is updated to any raw level after 45 ms and the toggle fires whenever stable==LOW, a slow or noisy release that dips LOW again after settling can produce an extra toggle; the state machine does not latch that a press was already consumed until a clean HIGH is seen.

bugs.title: Debounce timer never initialized, first press may be missed
bugs.description: reqEdge starts at 0 and is only set when raw changes; if the button is already LOW at boot or the first transition happens before millis() reaches DEBOUNCE_MS, the (now - reqEdge) >= DEBOUNCE_MS check can pass immediately or the edge timestamp is stale, causing the first request to be accepted without 35 ms of stability. Initialize reqEdge = millis() in setup and only accept a stable LOW after a full debounce window from the actual edge.

bugs.title: Unlock not guaranteed within 200 ms of door open
bugs.description: The door-open check runs every loop so unlock is fast, but there is no explicit timing guarantee and the lock is re-engaged logic-free; more importantly the door-open branch calls setLock(false) unconditionally every loop, which is fine, but the real issue is the request path can re-lock in the same loop iteration after unlock if the button is still held, violating 'wait for a new request after unlock'.

bugs.title: Re-engages while button held after unlock
bugs.description: After the door opens and unlocks, if the request button is still held LOW (stableReq already LOW), the engage condition stableReq==LOW && doorClosed() && !locked can fire again once the door closes without a new press, because there is no edge/latch requirement — only a level check. Need to require a fresh HIGH->LOW transition after unlock.

bugs.title: No rate limit on fan toggles
bugs.description: The sketch never enforces the 'max 2 state changes per 5000 ms' rule; rapid threshold crossings or boost release can toggle the fan more often than allowed.

bugs.title: Boost release leaves fan stuck ON
bugs.description: When boost is released, the hold counters are stale/zero and the fan stays ON until a fresh 4-sample OFF hold completes, but more importantly the forced-ON state isn't re-evaluated against temperature, so fan can remain ON below OFF_C for up to 200 ms and the boost override isn't cleanly cleared.

bugs.title: ADC reference scaling assumes 5 V
bugs.description: sampleTempC uses 5000 mV full-scale with 1023 divisor; on a 5 V Uno this is approximately correct but the divisor should be 1024 for proper LSB scaling, causing a small systematic temperature error near thresholds.

bugs.title: Boost not debounced
bugs.description: D4 is read directly each 50 ms sample with no debounce; a noisy or bouncing button can momentarily force the fan ON and count as a state change, violating the toggle-rate limit.

bugs.title: Pulse length is 2000 ms not 800 ms
bugs.description: PULSE_MS is set to 2000, so the injector stays HIGH for 2 s instead of the specified 800 ms.

bugs.title: Debounce timer never initialized
bugs.description: trigEdge starts at 0, so on the first loop the 25 ms stability check can pass immediately against a stale edge time, allowing an unsettled trigger to fire; trigEdge should be initialized to millis() in setup.

bugs.title: Blink timing uses 8-bit millis slice
bugs.description: The sketch compares (uint8_t)millis() differences against HALF_MS=500, but an 8-bit slice wraps every 256 ms, so the 500 ms threshold is never reached and the beacon never toggles or emits ticks.

bugs.title: Quiet hold does not pause blink schedule
bugs.description: While quiet is held, lastSlice is continuously reset to nowSlice, so on release the full 500 ms interval restarts instead of resuming the paused schedule; the behaviour requires pausing, not resetting, the blink phase.

bugs.title: Status telemetry uses blocking millis subtraction without rollover safety
bugs.description: The status interval check uses now - lastStatus >= STATUS_MS with unsigned long, which is rollover-safe, but the blink logic's 8-bit slice makes the overall timing unreliable; additionally, the status print can be delayed by serial blocking, causing jitter beyond the ±120 ms tick tolerance.

bugs.title: Toggles on release instead of press
bugs.description: risingEdge() fires on LOW-to-HIGH, which is the release edge of an active-LOW key, so the LED toggles on release rather than on press.

bugs.title: No debounce/settle window
bugs.description: The sketch reads the key every loop with no 40 ms settle window, so contact bounce on press and release produces multiple toggles.

bugs.title: No hysteresis on key state
bugs.description: There is no stable-state tracking, so a noisy or marginal key level can toggle the LED repeatedly instead of requiring a settled edge.

bugs.title: Blocking chime pulse starves heartbeat
bugs.description: pulseChimeBlocking() uses delay(1800), so the loop cannot print the 300 ms heartbeat for 1.8 s, violating the 700 ms silence limit and the requirement to print gate-hb while the chime sounds.

bugs.title: No debounce or settling on gate contact
bugs.description: gateOpened() triggers on a single raw LOW sample, so contact bounce or a brief glitch can start a chime even though the behaviour requires a settled 40 ms open event.

bugs.title: Chime retriggers while already sounding
bugs.description: Because the pulse is blocking and there is no active-pulse state, a held-open gate restarts the chime immediately after each pulse instead of ignoring presses while the chime is sounding.

bugs.title: No 150 ms response deadline enforcement
bugs.description: The sketch has no non-blocking state machine tracking the open event and pulse start, so it cannot guarantee the chime starts within 150 ms of a settled open event.

bugs.title: Flow not scaled to L/h
bugs.description: readFlowLph returns raw ADC counts instead of converting to millivolts (counts * 5000/1023) and dividing by 2 mV/Lph, so printed flow and alarm threshold are wrong by a large factor.

bugs.title: Logging every 2 s instead of 500 ms
bugs.description: loop uses delay(2000) and logs unconditionally, so serial output occurs every ~2 s, violating the 500 ms logging requirement and the 900 ms silence limit.

bugs.title: Alarm threshold uses raw counts
bugs.description: flowLooksLow compares raw ADC counts against 100 L/h, so the alarm state does not correspond to the actual flow in L/h.

bugs.title: No hysteresis on alarm
bugs.description: The alarm turns off immediately when flow rises above 100 L/h (and the HIGH_FLOW_LPH branch is redundant), causing chatter around the threshold; a hysteresis band is needed.

bugs.title: Limit polarity inverted
bugs.description: limitActiveRaw() and the hit check treat HIGH as active, but with INPUT_PULLUP the switch reads LOW when pressed, so the motor is disabled when the limit is clear and enabled when hit — exactly backwards.

bugs.title: Motor never disabled when jog released
bugs.description: The else branch calls setMotor(true), so the motor stays enabled whenever the limit is clear regardless of jog; the jog input has no effect and the motor is always on when clear.

bugs.title: Debounce edge timer not reset on stable match
bugs.description: limitEdge is only updated on raw change; if raw returns to stableLimit the timer is stale, and the debounce logic can accept a state without a full 25 ms of stability, and hitCount increments on the wrong transition.

bugs.title: No debounce/settle window
bugs.description: The sketch toggles on every raw falling edge with no 50 ms settle window, so a 22 ms bounce burst produces multiple toggles per physical press.

bugs.title: No hysteresis on release
bugs.description: priorSample is updated every loop with the raw sample, so bounce on release (HIGH/LOW chatter) can create spurious falling edges and extra toggles.

bugs.title: Unused bootMs variable
bugs.description: bootMs is assigned but never used; harmless but indicates the intended settle timing was never implemented.

bugs.title: Debounce timer reset on every raw change prevents settling
bugs.description: trigEdge is reset whenever raw differs from lastTrig, so a bouncing contact keeps restarting the 25 ms window; the stable state only updates after 25 ms of no raw changes, which is correct in intent but the edge tracking uses lastTrig rather than the stable value, so a brief glitch that returns to the stable level still resets the timer and can delay or miss a valid 30 ms press.
bugs.category_note: actually the logic is mostly OK; see b2

bugs.title: Pulse start latency can exceed 120 ms
bugs.description: The press is only accepted after DEBOUNCE_MS of stability plus loop latency, and because trigEdge is set on the first raw change, a 30 ms press that bounces can push detection past the 120 ms requirement; the debounce should latch on the stable LOW and start the pulse immediately when stable.

bugs.title: millis rollover breaks debounce and heartbeat comparisons
bugs.description: All timing uses unsigned subtraction which is rollover-safe, so this is not a bug; however trigEdge is initialized to 0 and if a press occurs before 25 ms after boot the subtraction is fine. No rollover bug present.

bugs.title: RPM scaling wrong by ~10x
bugs.description: readRpm returns millivolts (raw*5000/1023) but the spec is 1 mV per rpm, so the printed value is ~10x too high (e.g. 2000 rpm reads ~2000 mV→~9775). Must divide by 1 mV/rpm, i.e. rpm = mV.

bugs.title: Serial format wrong
bugs.description: Prints 'rpm: <n>' with a space and lowercase, but spec requires 'RPM:<n>' with no space after the colon.

bugs.title: Min/max never reset per second
bugs.description: rpmMin/rpmMax accumulate over the whole run instead of being reset each second, so the per-second 'spindle min/max' line reports lifetime extremes, not the current second's.

bugs.title: Warn threshold uses unscaled value
bugs.description: updateWarn compares the millivolt value against WARN_RPM=2000, so the lamp lights at ~200 rpm instead of 2000 rpm.

bugs.title: Debounce timer reset on every loop while bouncing
bugs.description: btnChanged is reset to now on every loop iteration where btn differs from lastBtn, so a noisy/bouncing input that toggles each read keeps pushing the settle deadline forward; a 40 ms press can be missed if the last bounce occurs late, and the press may not be recognized within the 150 ms window.

bugs.title: Heartbeat can be delayed past 700 ms silence
bugs.description: The heartbeat uses 'now - lastHb >= HB_MS' with lastHb set to now, which is fine, but the siren pulse and debounce logic are non-blocking so this is actually OK; however the real issue is that lastHb is only updated when the condition fires, and if loop is delayed the heartbeat drifts — minor. The genuine bug is the debounce reset above.

bugs.title: No unlock on door open
bugs.description: The sketch never drives D9 LOW when the door opens (D3 HIGH); once locked it stays locked forever, violating the unlock-within-200ms requirement.

bugs.title: Debounce edge timer not initialized
bugs.description: reqEdge starts at 0, so on the first loop the debounce window is measured from millis()=0 rather than the actual edge; combined with the missing unlock this can cause a spurious immediate engage or missed engage at startup.

bugs.title: No sensor fault detection
bugs.description: The behaviour requires forcing the compressor OFF when the probe is floating or reads below 0 °C or above 60 °C, but the sketch never checks for these conditions, so a disconnected probe (raw near 0 or floating) can leave the compressor running or cycling incorrectly.

bugs.title: Floating probe not detected
bugs.description: A floating A3 input reads an arbitrary value; without a plausibility check the sketch treats it as a valid temperature and may command the compressor ON, violating the failsafe requirement.

bugs.title: ADC reference scaling assumes 5 V
bugs.description: readTempC uses 5000.0f/1023.0f, which is only correct with a 5 V reference; on the Uno default reference this is approximately right, but the code should use the actual AVcc reference and 1024 divisor for accurate 10 mV/°C scaling, otherwise temperature is slightly off and band crossings shift.

bugs.title: Failsafe not applied within 500 ms
bugs.description: Even if a fault check were added, the current loop only acts on temperature every 50 ms with a 3-sample hold; the fault path must bypass the hold and force OFF immediately to meet the 500 ms requirement.

bugs.title: Wrong serial format for Temp line
bugs.description: Prints `temp=<value>` instead of the required `Temp: <celsius>` with a space after the colon, so the serial output does not match the specified format.

bugs.title: Freeze captures live value instead of last sample
bugs.description: While D5 is held LOW, frozenC is continuously overwritten with the current reading, so the value is not frozen at the last sample before the button was pressed; it keeps tracking the probe.

bugs.title: ADC scaling uses 1023 instead of 1024
bugs.description: volts = raw*(5/1023) introduces a small scale error; the correct full-scale divisor for the ATmega328P ADC is 1024, which keeps the reading within the ±1.5 °C tolerance.

bugs.title: Sample counter increments every loop, not per second
bugs.description: samples++ runs on every loop iteration rather than once per print period, so `weather n=` reports a rapidly growing loop count instead of the number of samples taken each second.

bugs.title: Freeze updates frozen value instead of holding last sample
bugs.description: While D5 is held LOW the code assigns frozenC = tempC every loop, so the reported value keeps tracking the live sensor instead of freezing at the last sample taken before the button was pressed. The frozen value should be latched once on the press edge (or on the last sample before hold).

bugs.title: ADC reference scaling uses 1023 instead of 1024
bugs.description: volts = raw * (5.0/1023.0) overstates the voltage by ~0.1% (up to ~5 mV at full scale), which is ~0.5 °C error at the top of the range; the correct divisor for a 10-bit ADC is 1024.0.

bugs.title: Sample counter increments every loop, not per second
bugs.description: samples++ runs on every loop iteration (thousands per second), so `weather n=` reports a meaningless rapidly-growing count rather than the number of 1-second samples; it should increment once per print period.

bugs.title: Missing 500 mV zero offset in kPa conversion
bugs.description: millivoltsToKpa divides raw millivolts by 10 without subtracting the 500 mV zero offset, so every printed pressure is 50 kPa too high and the D12 lamp lights at the wrong physical pressure.

bugs.title: ADC span uses 1023 instead of 1024
bugs.description: The 5.000 V span is divided by 1023 rather than 1024, biasing the millivolt reading slightly high; combined with the offset error this pushes the printed value outside the ±2.0 kPa tolerance.

bugs.title: Relay pin mismatch
bugs.description: RELAY_PIN is defined as 7 but the pin map specifies D8, so the relay is driven on the wrong pin and D8 never toggles.
